name: im-notify-kit
description: 飞书 / 企业微信群机器人通知的发送层：业务码校验、重试、超时、告警去重、卡片构建器。零依赖，跨 Node / Cloudflare Workers / Deno。Send layer for Feishu (Lark) & WeCom bot webhooks — biz-code aware, retrying, timeout-guarded, with alert dedupe.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --rootDir src --outDir dist
scripts.compat: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
